outcome: emergency caesarean section (compared to elective caesarean section)
cohort: Pregnant women aged 18 to 47 years who delivered by caesarean section at the Akyem Oda Government Hospital in Ghana were included.
finding: Birth weight less than 3.5 kg was inversely associated with emergency caesarean section, while maternal factors were positively associated with emergency caesarean section.
mod_finding: Birth weight less than 3.5 kg was inversely associated with emergency caesarean section, while maternal factors were positively associated with emergency caesarean section.
birth_weight: Measured; a birth weight less than 3.5 kg was found to be inversely associated with emergency CS.
